lines.text: This community's primary language is actually a blend of 60% emotes, 30% "no cap," and 10% actual words. We're basically fluent in vibes at this point.
Everyone in chat has exactly one (1) functioning keyboard key they use for all messages. That key is spacebar.
That logo's been floating in the void for a while now. We waiting for something to load, or just accepting this as content?
